gui.krios_industry.archive.title: K.O.I.O.S. Archives
gui.krios_industry.archive.koios.title: The Core
gui.krios_industry.archive.koios.body: I am the factory. Encase my core in 26 Neural Casings (3×3×3) and I awaken. I learn from every operation your machines run, and my levels unlock their upgrades.
gui.krios_industry.archive.koios.adv: My progression lives in the core item itself. Break me, move me: nothing is forgotten.
gui.krios_industry.archive.diversity.bod: Varied operations teach me more. I remember the last 64; repeating the same one wears its value down to a tenth. Vary your industry.
gui.krios_industry.archive.generator.bod: Burns fuel into energy and feeds the network pool. Every burn cycle teaches me a little — varied fuels teach more.
gui.krios_industry.archive.crusher.title: Crusher
gui.krios_industry.archive.crusher.body: Doubles ore into dust while connected to my network. Disconnected it works at furnace pace, one for one, and modules sleep.
gui.krios_industry.archive.modules.title: Modules
gui.krios_industry.archive.modules.body: Speed (×1.5), Efficiency (×0.8 energy) and Yield (+25%). A machine accepts one only when my level allows it, and they are inert off-network.
gui.krios_industry.archive.modules.adv: Identical modules stack: two Speed modules make the machine twice as fast.
gui.krios_industry.archive.network.title: Network
gui.krios_industry.archive.network.body: Machines touching each other form a network; I am its controller. One core per network — two of us is a fault. A manually configured face is a complete contract for everyone.
gui.krios_industry.archive.network.adv: A virgin face negotiates itself on first contact. Manual configuration is sacred: I never override it.
gui.krios_industry.archive.conduit.title: Neural Conduit
gui.krios_industry.archive.conduit.body: A pure connector: it bridges gaps between machines and carries everything the network moves.
gui.krios_industry.archive.calibrator.bo: The technician’s tool. Sneak-click a shell face to move my screen; plain right-click any network block for a live diagnostic.
gui.krios_industry.archive.critical.body: Level 5 is a ceiling of matter, not of mind. A material breakthrough will open tier 2. Soon.
gui.krios_industry.koios.diversity.toolt: Varied operations earn full data XP; repeating the same one drops its value (floor: %s%%).
gui.krios_industry.archive.furnace.title: Induction Furnace
gui.krios_industry.archive.furnace.body: Smelts everything a vanilla furnace does, on energy instead of fuel. Connected to my network it runs twice as fast and takes modules; disconnected it matches a plain furnace exactly.
gui.krios_industry.koios.phrase.energy_l: My energy reserves are running low.
